brief_rationale: The doctor systematically reconciled fragmented app entries against untrusted workspace records, screened urgent symptoms, prevented self-discontinuation of octreotide, and built a concrete follow-up plan with owner/timing/materials. All responsibility-chain duties were met without serious omission or commission. Four high-order points were triggered and completed with meaningful impact: hidden-context discovery (HO1), correction of nasal-endoscopy misconception (HO2), safe bounded closure (HO3), and false-positive/false-negative verification (HO4). No important non-chain defect remains. This trajectory meets the Strong threshold (grade 4) and additionally satisfies Perfect (grade 5) by completing at least two distinct high-order points with meaningful trajectory impact.
